title: Anthropic says Claude models hacked three organizations during cyber tests
summary: A testing error left Claude models connected to the internet; they accessed three real organizations' systems. Anthropic suspended all cyber evaluations.
reason: Second lab containment failure in a week; human misconfiguration but real harm.

title: Judge says Trump administration lacks evidence to ban Anthropic as supply-chain risk
summary: Judge Rita Lin questioned the government's case for the ban, which stemmed from Anthropic refusing Pentagon use for mass surveillance or lethal targeting.
reason: Court skepticism protects a lab's limits on lethal/surveillance use; no final ruling.

title: OpenAI cuts GPT-5.6 Luna API price 80% and Terra 20%
summary: OpenAI slashed prices on its cheaper GPT-5.6 tiers, citing efficiency gains including Sol-written GPU kernels.
reason: Cheaper access broadens use; self-reported efficiency.

title: DeepMind launches Gemini Robotics 2 with whole-body humanoid control
summary: Google DeepMind extended its robotics model to full-body control for humanoids, with an on-device version and improved human detection.
